name: Twilio
description: Sends SMS and MMS through Twilio with a restricted API key, reads delivery status and replies by polling, and keeps a consented-recipients list and opt-outs on the twilio site. Dry run by default; sends only to your numbers or person-activated consented recipients; never buys numbers or deletes anything.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: dryRun checks and reports each text and never sends. send sends for real.

sendAllowlist.label: Send allowlist
sendAllowlist.description: Your cell and any other number texts may always go to, up to 20. +country format (+15551234567); 10 US digits are read as +1.

fromNumber.label: From number
fromNumber.description: Your Twilio number texts come from, in +country format. Empty: the account's only SMS number is used; check says when there is none or several.

messagePrefix.label: Message prefix
messagePrefix.description: Put at the start of every text: your business name as the campaign registered it, such as "Acme Plumbing: ". A text that already starts with that name is left as it is. At most 40 characters.

messagingServiceSid.label: Messaging Service SID
messagingServiceSid.description: A Messaging Service SID (MG and 32 hex characters). Set it to send through the service your A2P 10DLC campaign is registered on; empty sends from fromNumber.

allowConsentedRecipients.label: Text consented recipients
allowConsentedRecipients.description: In send mode, also text the active entries of the consented list on the twilio page. Refused while the account is Trial or the number is not registered.

maxConsentedRecipients.label: Most consented recipients
maxConsentedRecipients.description: The most active consented entries honoured; the earliest activated win.

dailySendCap.label: Daily send cap
dailySendCap.description: Real texts sent per UTC day, across all recipients; dry runs do not count. A safety brake of the plugin, not a Twilio limit: a Low Volume Mixed 10DLC campaign allows about 2,000 a day.

perRecipientDailyCap.label: Daily cap per recipient
perRecipientDailyCap.description: Real texts sent to one number per UTC day.

mediaUrlHosts.label: Media URL hosts
mediaUrlHosts.description: Host names MMS media may come from, up to 20, each a public https host. Empty: MMS is refused in send mode.

optOutFooter.label: Opt-out footer
optOutFooter.description: Ends texts with "Reply STOP to opt out.": every text, the first text to each number, or off. A text that already says "Reply STOP" is left as it is.

privacyUrl.label: Privacy policy URL
privacyUrl.description: The https address of the privacy policy your campaign registered. Shown by check beside what every text carries.

termsUrl.label: Terms URL
termsUrl.description: The https address of the terms your campaign registered. Shown by check beside what every text carries.

autoReply.label: Auto-reply
autoReply.description: Answer each new text with autoReplyText at the next poll, by itself and through every check a send has: dry run records it, only sendAllowlist numbers or active consented recipients, never an opted-out number or a STOP, START or HELP text.

autoReplyText.label: Auto-reply text
autoReplyText.description: The auto-reply, at most 300 characters. messagePrefix and the opt-out line are added as for any text. Empty: no auto-reply is sent and check says so.

autoReplyOncePerHours.label: Auto-reply once per hours
autoReplyOncePerHours.description: At most one auto-reply to a number in this many hours.

ownerCommands.label: Owner commands
ownerCommands.description: Let you text a keyword (ownerKeywords) from your own phone to have the team act on it at the next poll, such as "summary" for a short text back. The plugin matches the keyword and publishes plugin.twilio-plugin.command naming only the keyword; the text itself is never an instruction to anyone. A spoofed sender can at worst make the team text your own number.

ownerNumbers.label: Owner numbers
ownerNumbers.description: The numbers that may send owner commands, up to 20, in +country format (+15551234567); 10 US digits are read as +1. Empty: the numbers on sendAllowlist. An owner number also needs to be on sendAllowlist for the answer to be sent.

ownerKeywords.label: Owner keywords
ownerKeywords.description: The owner command keywords, separated by commas: at most 20, each 1 to 32 letters, digits and spaces. A text is a command when its whole body, in any case and without a trailing ? ! or ., is one of them. STOP, START, HELP and the other opt-out, opt-in and help keywords are never commands.

accountSid.label: Account SID
accountSid.description: Account SID: now held by the API-key connection bound to the `twilio` slot (Twilio preset), set in Team settings -> Connections. Declared only so an update carries an existing value over to that connection.

apiKeySid.label: API key SID
apiKeySid.description: API key SID: now held by the API-key connection bound to the `twilio` slot (Twilio preset), set in Team settings -> Connections. Declared only so an update carries an existing value over to that connection.

apiKeySecret.label: API key secret
apiKeySecret.description: API key secret: now held by the API-key connection bound to the `twilio` slot (Twilio preset), set in Team settings -> Connections. Declared only so an update carries an existing value over to that connection.

twilio.description: The Twilio account to text through: an API-key connection with the Twilio preset (Account SID, API key SID and the secret of a Restricted API key), made in Team settings -> Connections.

publishes.summary: One text twilio sent: an sms or mms command in send mode, or an auto-reply during poll. A dry run sends nothing and publishes nothing here. Never carries the text.

fields.name: number
fields.summary: Our Twilio number the text went from (E.164); empty when it went through a Messaging Service and Twilio had not yet chosen the number.

fields.name: to
fields.summary: The recipient (E.164), in the same form as from in plugin.twilio-plugin.received.

fields.name: sid
fields.summary: The SID Twilio gave the text.

fields.name: autoReply
fields.summary: true when the text is an auto-reply sent during poll.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.

publishes.summary: New texts to our Twilio number that are not opt-out keywords. Snippets are untrusted content from the sender.

fields.name: number
fields.summary: Our number the texts arrived at.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: How many texts the event lists.

fields.name: messages
fields.summary: Each text: sid, from, date, snippet (at most 160 characters, inside untrusted-content markers), media (count), and autoReplied: true when twilio auto-replied to it.

fields.name: autoReplied
fields.summary: While autoReply is on: how many of the new texts twilio auto-replied to. Never send another reply to those.

fields.name: more
fields.summary: How many more new texts did not fit; list in shows them.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.

publishes.summary: Numbers that texted an opt-out keyword since the last poll. A 21610 on a send also marks the number opted out but publishes nothing here; the failing command or plugin.twilio-plugin.delivery reports it.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: How many numbers opted out.

fields.name: numbers
fields.summary: Each: number, keyword, date.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.

publishes.summary: Opted-out numbers that texted START, UNSTOP or YES. Only a person re-activates a consented entry.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: How many numbers.

fields.name: numbers
fields.summary: Each: number, keyword, date.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.

publishes.summary: Sent texts reached a final status with failures, or the setup test text was delivered.

fields.name: delivered
fields.summary: How many texts were delivered in this poll.

fields.name: failed
fields.summary: Each failed text: sid, to, status, error_code, error (the plugin's sentence for it).

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.

publishes.summary: An owner number texted exactly one of ownerKeywords, while ownerCommands is on. Names the keyword only, never the rest of the text. One event per command text; the text is not also in plugin.twilio-plugin.received and is never auto-replied to.

fields.name: command
fields.summary: The keyword, in lower case, as written in ownerKeywords.

fields.name: from
fields.summary: The owner number that sent it (E.164).

fields.name: at
fields.summary: When it was sent (UTC, RFC 3339).

fields.name: messageSid
fields.summary: The SID of the inbound text.

fields.name: dryRun
fields.summary: Always false.
